Body.Content:
Dynamics 365 Activate - CRM Migrate, is an AI-powered migration solution that simplifies and accelerates the transition from legacy CRMs (currently supporting migrations from Salesforce) to Microsoft Dynamics 365. It helps organizations assess their existing legacy CRM environments, understand data structures and dependencies, and streamline migration through intelligent schema mapping, automated data migration, and AI-assisted recommendations. By reducing manual effort and simplifying complex migration activities, Dynamics 365 Activate enables customers and partners to modernize their CRM environments with greater speed and confidence.

GA date: November CY2026
